byField.description:
Make links from the center type be from the fields that make the reference, rather than the center type itself.
If supported by the graph format, all these fields will form a subgraph. References _to_ the center type will
still be from the referencing types (not their fields).

singleLinks.description:
Sqash multiple links between types into a single one. There may be multiple links if one to refers to the same
type multiple ways (for example by mixing it in and referencing it in a field). This will be the default for
graph formats that don't support tagging edges with a reference type.
